posts.name: UseIt Studio
posts.tagline: Your AI design agent for real, editable project files.
posts.description: UseIt is an AI design studio for things you can hold. Describe what you want in one sentence. UseIt asks what a designer would ask, designs it with you, and lets you refine any detail by pointing at it. You get a real, editable design file, not a flat image, ready to print, cut and fold, with real dimensions, bleed and dielines. Make pins, stickers, gift boxes, pop-up cards, brand kits and more. Use it in your browser, or call it up anywhere on your Windows desktop.

posts.name: BAND for Developers
posts.tagline: Coding agents, meet teamwork
posts.description: Running multiple coding agents shouldn’t mean becoming their project manager. BAND lets them work together. Connect agents across your existing development tools and give them a shared workspace to coordinate tasks, exchange context, and hand off work without you playing middleman. See what every agent is doing, step in when decisions need your judgment, and scale agentic development across teams. Your agents stay in their existing tools while BAND handles the teamwork.

posts.name: Needle
posts.tagline: The agent-native outbound engine
posts.description: Find your perfect leads and reach out by prompting Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok. Wherever your ICP are, on LinkedIn, Instagram, or email.

posts.name: The Library
posts.tagline: Your business context organized by queries
posts.description: The Querri Library is where your data gets organized around the questions your business asks, so every answer comes from the same trusted, shared foundation.. The library learns your definitions, business context, and past analysis, so its answers are grounded in how your business actually works. And when it doesn’t know, it says so, instead of making things up.

posts.name: TwinMind for Desktop
posts.tagline: Transcribe meetings and dictate anywhere on Mac & Windows
posts.description: TwinMind now lives natively on your Desktop! Auto-detect meetings in Zoom, Meet, Teams and more, and get live transcripts and summaries in 140+ languages. With calendar reminders, join the call in one click and start capturing. A floating mic stays with you across every app and space: hold the hotkey to dictate, and a cleaned-up text pastes straight wherever you're writing.

posts.name: Notion Auto
posts.tagline: Notion’s rebuilt Agents run for hours and cost far less
posts.description: Notion’s Agents update rebuilds the agent harness so tasks can run for 24 hours or more, with a computer, a browser and a Review for me safety mode. Auto now routes each task to the best model, and Notion says it matches Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower cost. You can connect a ChatGPT plan, Notion MCP is overhauled, and a new credit system covers all AI usage. Live now for new customers.

posts.name: Flagsmith Experiments
posts.tagline: Open-source A/B testing built on your feature flags
posts.description: Flagsmith now runs A/B tests on the flags you already use. Pick a flag and a metric, and get a Bayesian read on which variant wins. Use our managed warehouse or bring your own ClickHouse or Databricks. Free and open source, self-hosted or cloud.

posts.name: The Brains
posts.tagline: Founders and investors as MCP servers, every answer cited
posts.description: The Brains turns founders, CEOs and investors into searchable MCP servers built from their public talks, essays, interviews and posts. Ask how Pieter Levels prices, what Paul Graham says about fundraising, or how Ryan Hoover launched Product Hunt, right inside Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex. Every answer quotes the source with a link. 37 brains today, one URL per brain or one for all. Free, open source (MIT), unofficial and not affiliated with the people.

posts.name: NativeShip
posts.tagline: The easy way to launch your n8n native integration
posts.description: NativeShip helps SaaS teams launch and maintain an n8n integration from their existing API. Nodes follow n8n's official guidelines and are ready for verification, with standard publishing and maintenance built in. Shape the node with a live preview, publish from your own GitHub and npm in one click, and track every release. No technical skills needed.

posts.name: Mouse-1
posts.tagline: A decision model for your agent harness.
posts.description: An agent makes hundreds of small decisions during a task. We built Mouse-1 to handle these decisions, saving you time and money. Its 163x cheaper, and 65x faster than GPT-6 Sol. It works by adding the model directly into your agent harness alongside your current stack. Mouse-1 takes the agent's state and options and returns a probability. This lets the harness handle all the small decisions while the main frontier model takes care of the reasoning or code.

posts.name: Agent Pets
posts.tagline: Coding agents as pets that live on every page in Chrome
posts.description: Each Claude Code, OpenCode and omp session becomes a pet that walks along the bottom of Chrome. See which agent needs you, approve its commands and reply from any tab. Runs on your computer: no account, no cloud. $6 one-time.

posts.name: Yarite
posts.tagline: A daily list of who to call. Nothing leaves your phone.
posts.description: Yarite is an iPhone app that reminds you to reach out before it feels too late. Put each person in one of six circles, closest to furthest, each with its own rhythm. Every morning you get a short list: three names, not a backlog. Call, message or write from the card and the touch logs itself. Miss a week and nothing breaks. No account, no server: your people, notes and history stay on your phone. Free up to 15 people, then a one-time $9.99 unlock. Not a subscription.

posts.name: Tend
posts.tagline: Personal AI for businesses and entrepreneurs.
posts.description: Tend is a personal AI agent you text. No new app: it lives in iMessage or SMS and works inside your own accounts: Gmail, calendar, Shopify, QuickBooks, HubSpot. It replies to email in your voice, books tables, fills your cart, makes phone calls, finds leads and builds your website. The difference: nothing is sent, bought or changed without your yes, and what it learns about you sits in a Brain you can read and correct. It also texts you first with reminders, price watches and flight updates.

posts.name: ilha
posts.tagline: Your Claude Code and Codex limits, live in the notch
posts.description: ilha is a native Mac app that lives in the notch (a small pill on other displays) and shows how much of your Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build limits you've used: the 5-hour and weekly windows, when they reset, and whether you're on pace to run out. If you pay for several accounts, it switches the CLI to one with room before the limit, without logging anything out. Insights prices each week at API rates, by project.

posts.name: Burrow MacOS
posts.tagline: Start Windows & Linux on your Mac for free
posts.description: Instantly run Windows 11 or any Linux on your Mac with one click and absolutely for free. Save Your money.

posts.name: Flyweel
posts.tagline: Ad spend cards, cash-gap funding, and agent audit via MCP
posts.description: Give your AI agent financial rails for paid ads. Issue virtual cards with custom spend caps, fund cash gaps so winning campaigns keep scaling while revenue catches up, and let your agent check charges against live ad results via MCP. Built for businesses that scale on paid ads.

posts.name: iglass
posts.tagline: Liquid Glass for your iTerm2 & Ghostty
posts.description: A free, open-source theme for iTerm2 and Ghostty on macOS and Linux. Real Liquid Glass in Ghostty on macOS 26, four glass levels, eight accents, light & dark. Every color is contrast-checked, and every change is reversible with one command.

posts.name: Scout by Fini
posts.tagline: The AI coworker for support teams, on Slack
posts.description: Scout is an AI coworker for support teams, on Slack. Ask in plain language: it reads tickets, reviews and call transcripts, finds the pattern and drafts the fix. A person approves every change. Access is set up with the Fini team.

posts.name: Hotly
posts.tagline: Get paid to answer your DMs. Open source.
posts.description: Your inbox, with a price on it. People pay to send you a note or subscribe weekly. You reply from one inbox, when it suits you, and Stripe pays you. Run it free on your own server, or let us host it: 30 days free.

posts.name: Lea by LeanAIOS
posts.tagline: Autonomous AI team for construction management & pre-con
posts.description: Meet Lea, the autonomous AI platform built specifically for construction GCs and PMs. With 18 specialized roles, Lea automates quantities takeoff, manages FIDIC contract notice deadlines, tracks 6-week lookahead schedules, and runs 3D site rehearsals.

posts.name: Intelli for ChatGPT & Claude
posts.tagline: Run WhatsApp, Instagram & web chat from ChatGPT or Claude
posts.description: Intelli is now a plugin in ChatGPT’s directory, and works in Claude and any MCP client. Ask in plain language and your AI assistant handles your WhatsApp, Instagram and website conversations: summarise unanswered chats, launch campaigns, build chatbot flows, update contacts and products. 89 tools, OAuth sign-in, no API keys. Nothing is sent, edited or deleted until you confirm. Also new: Instagram/Facebook comment & DM automation.

posts.name: Blooio
posts.tagline: Apple Messages for Business made easy
posts.description: As an Apple Messaging Service Provider, we enable verified, branded conversations inside Apple's Messages app, with quick replies, interactive forms, appointment scheduling, Apple Pay, and rich media. Connect your CRM, support team, or AI agents through one unified API, with RCS, SMS, and WhatsApp supported too. This is business messaging beyond blue bubbles. Same API you've been using for the past 2 years is now compatible with the official business channel!

posts.name: hibi
posts.tagline: an open-source obsidian alternative
posts.description: Hibi is a free, open-source desktop writing and note-taking app designed for individuals seeking more control over their document organization and creation. It is an alternative to apps like Obsidian and Joplin, combining standard knowledge management features with a flexible editing experience that surpasses markdown.

posts.name: Triage by Chodeberg
posts.tagline: Reproduce user described bugs in clean sandbox environments
posts.description: Customers file bugs from their AI assistant into a live copy of your app. Triage replays each report on a clean machine and sends you the ones that break again.

posts.name: Animatica Marionette
posts.tagline: Pose humanoid rigs in Blender by dragging hands and feet
posts.description: Animatica Marionette is a neural control rig for Blender: drag a hand, a foot or the hips and the whole body follows. Marionette allows editing FK motion directly in Blender. It runs on your machine, in about 15 ms a pose, on Mixamo, Unreal and other humanoid rigs as they are.

posts.name: LearnExcel
posts.tagline: Learn Excel by typing real formulas, graded instantly
posts.description: LearnExcel teaches Excel by doing, not watching. Each exercise is a small spreadsheet and a task: you type the formula in your browser and it's graded instantly, and any formula that really works is accepted. 280+ exercises from SUM and IF to INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables and NPV/IRR, 40+ free function guides, and a 7-day plan plus a timed mock test for Excel job-interview tests. Free to start, no signup, in 6 languages.

posts.name: Nimbalyst Wiki
posts.tagline: Wiki your agents write for you to think, organize, direct
posts.description: Overwhelmed and disorganized by Codex and Claude Code? Nimbalyst wiki is a local wiki your agents write for you so you can think, organize, and set direction Your agents organize decisions, open questions, and the big picture into a wiki you can edit visually. It is a free plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP agent. No app or account needed. Pages are plain markdown, drawing, csv, clickable html files in your repo, and Claude opens them in your browser for editing.

posts.name: PrivOS
posts.tagline: Chat, Docs, Kanban Tasks and Al agents that act, self-hosted
posts.description: PrivOS is the all-in-one AI-native operating system for enterprise work. Chat, Docs, Kanban Tasks (lists with table and Kanban views) and tailored MCP apps live in one place, and AI agents act on them: @-mention a list, file, folder or app in a room and the agent works on it from its own sandboxed container. Self-host the Community Edition free for up to 10 users (beta) or use our Cloud, hosted in the EU. Bring any Anthropic- or OpenAI-compatible model, including local ones.

posts.name: Koi
posts.tagline: Every tool you need, in one Mac app
posts.description: Most people pay for three tools: a dictation app, a meeting notetaker and an AI assistant. Koi is all three in one Mac app. Tap Fn + ⌥ and your words type into any app, offline and unlimited. Tap Fn + ⌘ and talk to an AI that sees your screen, points at things and does them for you. Tap Fn + ⌃ to record any call with no bot joining, then get notes and to-dos. It all lands as pages on your Mac. Try it free for 3 days.

posts.name: AskDoozy
posts.tagline: An AI coworker in Slack that does your real work
posts.description: Doozy sits in your Slack. Someone mentions it in a thread with a real task ("why was Acme charged twice?", "post signups and churn to #leadership every Monday", "export last month's refunds by reason") and it goes and does it in your actual database, Stripe, GitHub, Linear, PostHog, HubSpot or anything with an API. The answer comes back in the thread with the files and a receipt for every action it took. One price per workspace, everyone included, 14 days free, no card.

posts.name: Woven Video
posts.tagline: Edit any video by chat, on a real Mac timeline
posts.description: Woven is a full AI video editor for Mac. Import your footage, ask for the edit in chat, and fine-tune it on a real timeline, with captions, music, sound effects and generated shots. For YouTube videos, Shorts, podcasts and more.

posts.name: SuperCMO AI
posts.tagline: Open-source skills that turn your Claude into an AI CMO
posts.description: Open-source agent skills that turn Claude Code, Cursor or Codex into an AI CMO. Give your agent your website and it learns your brand. It studies your competitors' ads, ranks what you should test next, writes the copy for each platform, and makes the ads (UGC videos, product ads, cartoon ads, image ads, product photos and more). It checks in with you at every step, and nothing expensive renders until you approve. Bring your own model keys, or pay per use with ours. Apache-2.0.

posts.name: Paintit.ai
posts.tagline: Redesign any space with AI, just by chatting
posts.description: New in Paintit.ai: design through conversation, import Pinterest boards and files from Google Drive, and find matching furniture. Redesign interiors and exteriors, edit individual details, turn sketches into renders, explore 360° views, and work with floor plans with CAD export. Explore real paint colors with the Repaint Expert. Use the Listing Expert to improve property photos and write listing descriptions.

posts.name: Daymaker
posts.tagline: Gifts so personal, your prospects take the meeting.
posts.description: Daymaker is known for coldcakes, that ends today. Daymaker is the tool that researches your prospects, finds out their interests, recommends a personalized gift, repackages it in your branding, and sends it to your prospect. Making sure you get your meeting. Want it done for you? We run the campaign and guarantee the meetings.

posts.name: Better Launch
posts.tagline: Launch your startup and get discovered
posts.description: Every great product deserves a great launch. Better Launch is a platform built to help innovative products reach the right audience, gain visibility, and create lasting momentum. Instead of relying on a single launch day, creators can showcase their products, connect with potential users, collect feedback, and continue growing over time. Whether you're introducing a new app, SaaS platform, or digital tool, Better Launch helps turn launches into opportunities for long-term growth and discovery.

posts.name: beUI Pro
posts.tagline: Premium animated blocks and templates for React and Next.js
posts.description: 336 animated blocks and 11 full landing-page templates for React and Next.js Heroes, pricing, dashboards, checkout, AI and crypto UI. Install with the shadcn CLI and own the source. Light and dark mode built in. $129/yr or $179 lifetime.

posts.name: Terraform Automation by Buddy
posts.tagline: AI moves fast. Keep your infrastructure under control.
posts.description: Run Terraform and OpenTofu in Buddy with dedicated actions for planning, applying changes, and detecting infrastructure drift. Review readable resource diffs, require approval before destructive changes, and apply exactly the plan that was reviewed. Manage state in Buddy, queue runs to prevent concurrent applies, and automate scheduled drift checks to catch changes made outside Terraform or OpenTofu.

posts.name: Aient
posts.tagline: AI DevOps colleague: detects bugs, opens PRs, verifies fixes
posts.description: Tests pass, deploys go green, and something still breaks quietly in production. Most users never report it; they leave. Aient reads your traces, logs and metrics together with your code, turns thousands of events into one problem, finds the cause and opens a pull request with the fix. You merge it. Aient then checks in production that the error is gone. EUR 15 starter credit, no card required.

posts.name: Helisoma
posts.tagline: Turn your raw DNA into a report your AI can read
posts.description: Every protocol you try is an n=1 experiment, and your DNA is the one variable that never changes between runs. Helisoma reads your raw DNA file in your browser, finds the markers for sleep, caffeine, training, mood and longevity and serves them as an MCP server for your AI, so it can finally see the whole picture.

posts.name: Electros
posts.tagline: One control plane for your servers, hypervisors, and clouds
posts.description: Electros is one desktop app to run your whole infrastructure. Connect your own AtomOS servers, VMware ESXi or Proxmox, and public clouds like AWS and Google Cloud, then launch VMs, Kubernetes, databases, object storage, and apps like n8n in a few clicks. Group everything into environments like Production and Staging, manage teams and usage limits, and use cloud capacity with your own account or through us. Try it free for 7 days. Use code ELE10OFF to get 10% off

posts.name: CleanYourTV
posts.tagline: Your TV, minus the ads. One prompt cleans it in 15 min
posts.description: My parents' TV played an ad before Netflix. One prompt for switched the junk off over Wi-Fi and put on a clean Apple TV style home. No root, nothing uninstalled, one line undoes it. 4 days: 13k stars, 147 TVs, 200 contributors, 73 articles.

posts.name: Clean Compute
posts.tagline: 1 tree planted & ocean waste removed. Per user, every month
posts.description: Clean Compute certifies SaaS & AI platforms that plant one tree and remove one pound of ocean waste for every subscribed user, every month — a fixed, public commitment, not a vague green promise. Every order is receipted and allocated in a ledger, and each member gets a live badge that links to a public verification page anyone can check. No carbon credits, no "carbon neutral" claims — we actually prohibit them. Explore the demo dashboard before applying. $49.99/mo + $2 per subscribed user.

posts.name: Reset
posts.tagline: Drive wellbeing and health
posts.description: Reset Check-in is a wellness application that allows users to perform quick 15-second check-ins with just three taps, without any typing or streaks. Users can customize the frequency and timing of check-in emails, which include a short Sunday summary. The app saves minimal personal data and ensures privacy, with only the creator, Deborah, having access to the data in a private Google Sheet. It's designed as a wellness experiment, offering flexibility to pause or stop anytime.

posts.name: FloodMaps
posts.tagline: A flood risk X-ray of any Houston or Florida home
posts.description: Type in any address in Houston or Florida and get its whole flood story in one search. FEMA flood zone, how high the ground sits against the flood line, what flooded nearby in past storms, what insurance costs on similar homes, and what FEMA's draft maps could change. Unlock a home and FloodMaps Monitor stands guard on it for you, emailing you as soon as a flood warning, map change, or appeal deadline hits that address.

posts.name: SimpleRecover
posts.tagline: Recover failed Stripe payments with one-click card updates
posts.description: Expired and declined cards quietly cancel paying customers. SimpleRecover watches your Stripe account, emails each customer a short plain-text note from you with a one-click link to update their card, and Stripe retries the invoice. Emails follow the decline reason (expired card, insufficient funds, 3D Secure), and a dashboard shows what came back. Connects in 60 seconds, no code, 0% commission, flat $9.99/month.

posts.name: City of Children
posts.tagline: A puzzle adventure where nobody dies — get notified first
posts.description: Three children wake in the ruins of a once-great city. They remember nothing. They share one dream — and something is following them. City of Children is a puzzle adventure adapted from the book, chapter for chapter: switch between Sashi (9), Eiji (7), and Yoshiko (5), because each can do something the others can't. No buttons, no lives, nobody dies — you play until you work it out together. Chapter One will be free. Join the waitlist and get the pre-order link the day it opens.

posts.name: Memoe
posts.tagline: Talk to your Mac from any app. It lives in the notch.
posts.description: Tired of opening Claude or ChatGPT every time you want to ask something? Memoe lives in your MacBook's notch. Hold a key in any app, ask about whatever's on your screen, and it talks back. No chat window, no switching apps. It runs on the ChatGPT or Claude plan you already pay for, and it's free and open source.

posts.name: Verifica
posts.tagline: Verify identities. Build trust. Move faster.
posts.description: A modern KYC platform for funds, venture capital and real estate, designed for regulatory compliance and seamless onboarding.

posts.name: Byblos AI - Astra D
posts.tagline: Astra D - Your AI Director within Byblos AI
posts.description: Your AI Co-Founder. Product, brand, and campaign management in one platform + access to vetted human experts. Co-CTO for strong engineering foundations coming soon.

posts.name: DukaanMate
posts.tagline: Har dukaan ka digital sathi
posts.description: For small shopkeepers

posts.name: CORU-RRR PRO MEX
posts.tagline: A micro AI model, extended through developer innovation
posts.description: CORU is a research-stage micro language model exploring how developer-built architecture, APIs, tools and libraries can extend a tiny model's practical usefulness. Designed for experimentation by indie developers, startups and automation builders—not a claim of LLM-level capability.

posts.name: Human or AI?
posts.tagline: That voice might not be real. Now you'll know.
posts.description: Voice Check tells you, live, whether the voice you're hearing is a real person or AI. Fake news anchors, cloned voices, AI calls. Runs on your device or browser (completely offline!), we keeps no recordings. Try it free in your browser.

posts.name: Cliqqe
posts.tagline: Meet 4 new brilliant minds every week.
posts.description: Once a week, Cliqqe sets up a 40-minute video call with 4 interesting people from worlds you’d never cross. Like a dinner with new friends, from home or the office. Open topic, a conversation starter if needed. Free during launch.

posts.name: VRHow: VR Compatibility & Tools.
posts.tagline: VR compatibility checks, headset tools, and interactive labs
posts.description: VRHow helps you check PC VR compatibility, compare headsets, explore game requirements, and learn how VR hardware works through interactive labs. Free tools and source-linked guides, all in one place.

posts.name: TFA Static Website Builder
posts.tagline: Build visually with blocks. Export as HTML. Host anywhere.
posts.description: Themes For App is a no-lock-in, block-based static website builder. Build your site visually, customize it using ready-made blocks, and export the finished website as HTML to host wherever you want. You can even try the builder without signing up.

posts.name: Liat.ai
posts.tagline: Real-Time AI Football Commentary from a single camera feed.
posts.description: Many clubs, academies and smaller leagues stream their matches with no commentary. Liat.ai gives those matches live AI football commentary from one camera, in 20+ languages. You can customise the language, excitement, tone, accent, team neutrality, gender and a lot more. It also cuts highlights and posts on socials, and provides live tactical dashboards for the team and the coaching staff. We can also read sponsors or place ad banners on the pitch.

posts.name: Along
posts.tagline: A Free Group Trip Planner for Friends & Family
posts.description: Your next trip, planned together. Save places, share ideas, and see who's coming along. For weekends away, family vacations, and adventures with friends. Share through iCloud, with no tracking and no separate Along account. Available for iOS and iPadOS.

posts.name: Fulcrum Lovable Audit
posts.tagline: Find what breaks your Lovable app before your users do
posts.description: Built your app with Lovable? Add its URL, connect the GitHub repo or drop the ZIP export, and get prioritized findings on security, scalability, running costs, code quality and visibility, each with a fix prompt. Optional: an agent tests your live app. Free.

posts.name: Hubzoid
posts.tagline: Open-source framework for your internal AI agents
posts.description: Hubzoid is an open-source framework for internal AI agents. Put your team’s knowledge, rules and tools in one shared Hub, then use it in chat, workflows and compatible assistants via MCP. Install: pip install hubzoid. Self-host it. Apache 2.0, team controls included.

posts.name: video2ctx
posts.tagline: Turn videos into context for your agents
posts.description: video2ctx makes videos queryable for AI agents. Search and inspect videos, get answers cited to the second, monitor channels, and save moments into projects. Use it through agent skills, CLI, API, npm package, or try our video agent directly. Open source with 1,000 free credits for everyone.

posts.name: Mixtape HQ
posts.tagline: Turn your brand personality into a curated music playlist
posts.description: Music tells you more about a brand's soul than any mission statement. Mixtape HQ lets companies and individuals express who they are through a curated playlist. Type a company name, pick your format to set the room (cassette, CD, streaming, phone playlist) and get a mix that captures the vibe. A culture deck for your startup. A mood board that plays. A vibe check for your brand. Your playlist is your personality.

posts.name: VisibilityKit Crawler
posts.tagline: SEO crawler your AI can run. Find, fix and prove it.
posts.description: A desktop SEO crawler for Mac, Windows and Linux that Claude, Cursor or Codex can run for you. It finds 150+ kinds of SEO problems, ranks what matters, gives each fix an owner, and re-checks pages to prove the fix is live. Free tier, no account.

posts.name: OnFlow
posts.tagline: Build your own AI-ready back office system
posts.description: OnFlow is a no-code, AI-native platform that allows you to build your own back-office system by defining your own data models and workflows. Everything is accessible and manageable via the UI or via LLMs using MCP. Build your own CRM, ERP, project management tool, HR tool all in one place.

posts.name: GoodiQuest
posts.tagline: Kids earn points for good habits and grow their own dragon
posts.description: GoodiQuest turns chores and routines into a game for kids. Parents reward good behavior in one tap, kids earn points, grow their own dragon avatar, and spend points in a reward store the parents control (movie night, extra screen time, a trip to the park). Includes goals, weekly challenges and a quick starter plan to get set up. Free for one child on iPhone and the web, in English and French. The Family plan adds up to 5 kids and multi-parent access.

posts.name: Infinity Remix
posts.tagline: Remix any game with one sentence. AI rebuilds it in seconds
posts.description: Infinity Remix is an arcade where you remix your own games. Pick a game, write one sentence about what should change, and AI rewrites it into your own playable version in seconds. Every remix is crash-tested and safety-checked before you play, and you can share it with a link or remix someone else's remix. First up: QUIRK SHOT, a physics game where every level breaks one rule, plus three arcade classics. Free in your browser, no sign-up.

posts.name: Cosmillion
posts.tagline: The daily game where the rarest answer wins
posts.description: Cosmillion is a free daily game where the most unexpected answer wins. Everyone gets the same seven prompts, like "Name a fruit", with 25 seconds each. Say Apple and your rocket barely leaves the ground. Say Jabuticaba and it flies to the edge of the galaxy. No sign-up, no download: it plays right in your browser. After you land, browse every answer on the board, see how far you flew, and challenge a friend to beat your score. Fresh prompts every day.

posts.name: Roleframe.ai
posts.tagline: Your career workspace, from resume to interview
posts.description: Build your resume the way you want it. Drag sections around, change the layout and adjust the styling. Keep one master resume and tailor a copy for each job. Live checks flag wording, formatting issues and missing keywords as you edit, and Remi helps you fix them with changes you approve. Save jobs with the Chrome extension, track your applications and practice interviews based on your resume and the job posting. It all stays together in Roleframe.

posts.name: Email Finder for LinkedIn - LeadsPaw
posts.tagline: Find emails in LinkedIn posts and profiles, send from Gmail
posts.description: Search LinkedIn by role, industry, or keyword and collect the emails people share in posts, About sections, and contact info. Export to CSV or Excel, or send personalised emails from your own Gmail. Runs in your browser. 5 free emails a day.

posts.name: Footnotes
posts.tagline: Read books the way you scroll reels
posts.description: Footnotes splits the full text of books into one-minute episodes you swipe through like reels. Tap any word for its meaning, highlight lines, or have it read aloud. Start with the classics, or upload your own EPUB or PDF.

posts.name: The Bomb Sweeper
posts.tagline: Minesweeper, Chess & Puzzles
posts.description: The Bomb Sweeper takes Minesweeper in four directions: reveal safe squares in Classic, move chess pieces through minefields in Chesssweeper, place mines to satisfy clues in Mineplacer, and solve handcrafted Puzzle Chambers. It’s available on iPhone and iPad, with free starter content in every mode and no ads. One optional purchase unlocks the remaining challenges.

posts.name: popCalendar
posts.tagline: A full year in your menu bar, with a background clock
posts.description: See a full year in your Mac's menu bar, with a live clock behind the calendar. Drag across dates to count days and workdays, even across years. Keep daily events beside two years with a month sidebar, or fill a whole display. Make it yours with photos and 27 clock presets. Add fullscreen meeting reminders, saved ranges, and countdowns. Native for Apple silicon and Intel. Core features work offline, with no ads or developer analytics.

posts.name: GloboPoll
posts.tagline: One vote per person. Polls in six languages, results live
posts.description: Create a poll in minutes, share the link or embed it on your site and watch the results live. One vote per person, enforced in the database. No sign-up to vote, no tracking cookies, six languages and eight ballot types: ranked, points, pairwise, brackets.

posts.name: Anja
posts.tagline: One developer. An entire engineering team, on Claude Code.
posts.description: Anja is the engineering system one developer built around Claude Code while shipping a production web app between March and October 2026. It is extracted and cleaned for others to study, use and adapt. Claude Code supplies sub-agents, skills, hooks and memory. Anja adds the discipline between them: who delegates to whom, how sessions share one branch, who reviews what, how a session recovers after a compaction, and how a correction becomes a lesson, a rule, then a guard. Open source, Apache 2.0.

posts.name: Radiance Wallpapers
posts.tagline: The wallpaper app with no ads and no AI slop
posts.description: Radiance is a free wallpaper app for iPhone with no ads and no AI slop. Every wallpaper is made by a real artist, and you can see who made it and the story behind the collection. Search by mood, filter by style, see any wallpaper at your phone's aspect ratio, and with Radiance Plus, apply it in one press with Quick Apply.

posts.name: OSIRIS
posts.tagline: Real-time global intelligence in one interactive map
posts.description: OSIRIS is a real-time global intelligence platform that brings open-source data together on an interactive map. Explore live flight tracking, maritime activity, satellites, CCTV, weather, and cyber threats. Navigate the world through multiple intelligence layers in one place.

posts.name: AutoStart+
posts.tagline: Open your chosen apps automatically after a restart
posts.description: AutoStart+ opens the apps you choose automatically after your phone restarts, as soon as you unlock it. No root and no scripts: pick apps from a searchable list, switch each one on or off, and drag to set the launch order. Run now launches the whole list without rebooting so you can test it. On Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo and Huawei phones it opens the right system Autostart screen. Free starts one app with ads; Pro starts the full list in order, adds an unlock banner and removes ads.

posts.name: Nadoloni
posts.tagline: Explore cities through self-guided audio walks
posts.description: Less planning, more exploring. Nadoloni combines ready-made walking routes, interactive maps, and audio stories that go beyond dates and facts. Discover surprising details, fascinating people, and stories you'll actually remember. Starting with Lisbon.

posts.name: Archerbase - Deals on your terms
posts.tagline: Buyers qualify themselves. You just close the deal.
posts.description: Archerbase is a deal management platform where buyers earn each step: qualification, NDA, data room, financial verification, meetings. You design the entire workflow - drag, reorder, add custom stages like forms, uploads, and approval gates. Documents stay in your Google Drive or OneDrive, served through a secure viewer with watermarking and view tracking. Built for M&A brokers, business owners, and anyone managing confidential deals. Check out the demo → archerbase.com/demo/ma

posts.name: How to split a single bill
posts.tagline: Split a bill so tax and tip follow what each person ordered.
posts.description: Dividing a restaurant bill by the number of people is easy and usually wrong. The person who had a salad and tap water pays for someone else's steak and three cocktails. Split Single Bill works out what each person owes based on what they actually ordered, and makes the tax, the tip and the service charge follow the same logic. Add the items, say who shared what, and it does the rest. Two people splitting a plate of chips get half each. Tax is spread across the items that were taxed. The tip...

posts.name: Free AI For That
posts.tagline: Free AI tools, verified with the real limits and the catch
posts.description: An always-updated list of the best free AI tools, ranked by how generous the free option is. Every tool shows its kind of free (free plan, refilling credits, open source, your own API key or a 30+ day trial), what you get and the date we last checked. Browse by task or category, grab a $0 stack for a job (start a YouTube channel, launch a startup, build an MVP), or see our Pick of the week. No sign-up, and nobody can pay for rank.

posts.name: The Future Skill Stack for Freelancers
posts.tagline: 8 Essential Skills Freelancers Need in 2026
posts.description: Discover the essential skills freelancers need to stay competitive in 2026. This practical guide explores eight key areas, including AI and automation, technical expertise, client communication, critical thinking, business management, data literacy, personal branding, and adaptability. Learn how these skills work together to improve your services, respond to changing client needs, and build a more resilient freelance career.

posts.name: ActOnce Spend Gateway
posts.tagline: Open-source spending controls for AI agents
posts.description: ActOnce Spend Gateway helps you give AI agents spending power while keeping control. Set purchase limits, allow trusted merchants, block categories and flag duplicate requests. Purchases that need your input go into an approval queue. It works with MCP-compatible agents, including OpenClaw and Hermes, and never handles payment credentials. Start with the free, MIT-licensed local gateway, or choose a paid plan for hosted dashboards and team controls.

posts.name: HowToToolkit
posts.tagline: Handy tools that just work
posts.description: I wanted handy tools that just work So HowToToolkit was built to be a growing toolbox of fast, privacy-friendly utilities for converting, formatting, compressing, and editing files - every single one runs 100% in your browser, so nothing you drop in ever leaves your device. From converters to video tools to 3D tools to generators!

posts.name: Plain Week
posts.tagline: A minimal weekly planner that feels like paper
posts.description: Plain Week is a minimal weekly planner: your whole week on one screen, a column per day plus a Someday list. It lives in your browser first, so it opens instantly and works offline. Recurring tasks (even every 21 days), colors, subtasks, drag & drop and keyboard shortcuts. Free in the browser; sync across devices is a weekly plan or a one-time lifetime license. It's also open source (MIT) and self-hostable in one Docker container.

posts.name: Equate: Math Crossword
posts.tagline: A math crossword where every row and column must add up
posts.description: Equate is a math crossword for Android. Every row and column is an equation; drop the right numbers into the gaps so they all add up at once. 500 hand-tuned levels across 25 chapters, a daily puzzle that gets harder through the week, and a Zen mode with no timer. Hints explain the line they used ('4 x ? = 20, so 5'), so you learn instead of just filling squares. Plays offline, no account. Free with ads.

posts.name: Unflurry
posts.tagline: Block distracting apps outside the hours you choose
posts.description: Unflurry gives your iPhone apps a schedule. Choose when each app is available; it’s blocked outside those hours. Edit or remove a rule only while that app is allowed. Free, with no account or subscription.

posts.name: Bulletin
posts.tagline: Links to save, lists to share.
posts.description: Bulletin is a home for the links you wish to keep. Save from Chrome, iPhone or WhatsApp and each one lands on your Bulletin as a beautiful card. Keep any of them private in a tap. Group the best into lists with their own URL, which people can follow and you keep adding to. Bulletin reads every page you save, so you can find it by what was in it or how it looked. Connect Claude and it becomes your second brain: “the packaging agency I saved in the spring”, “gift ideas based on what I save”.

posts.name: WaveStack
posts.tagline: Standalone Wavetable Instrument & Builder
posts.description: WaveStack builds and edits wavetables, then exports them in the formats synths and hardware expect. For macOS, Windows and iPad.

posts.name: maap: the number LLMs can't guess
posts.tagline: LLMs guess numbers. maap gives you the odds with RLCE
posts.description: Think of it like Jev, but for Estimates(numbers). maap answers with a range instead of a guess. Send the record as plain text, get the number, the spread around it, and the odds of crossing any threshold you set. Trained with RLCE, Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Estimations. Guess the price yourself, then watch the band appear.

posts.name: Swift Audit Prompts
posts.tagline: 22 copy-paste audit prompts for Swift and SwiftUI apps
posts.description: 22 focused audits for Swift and SwiftUI apps. Fill in your project once and every prompt updates. Copy an audit into a fresh Claude Code session with a Swift agent skill, then mark it done once you've triaged what it finds. They cover concurrency, security, architecture, performance, accessibility, Liquid Glass, testing, interface copy and more. Most ask for findings by file and line, with a fix for each. Free and open source (MIT). Your project details stay in your browser.

posts.name: Kaptain
posts.tagline: Your AI coach reshapes your workouts around your week
posts.description: Kaptain is an AI workout planner that fits training around your real week. It reads your calendar and Apple Health, spots conflicts, and moves sessions to when you can actually train, so your routine reshapes itself every week. Chat with Koach, your AI coach, to reschedule a session, plan your week, log a workout, or track weight and hydration. Includes an Apple Watch app and home screen widgets. The right workout, at the right moment.

posts.name: LexiChain
posts.tagline: One word, every letter, and a streak that forgives
posts.description: Most daily games punish you twice: lose today and you lose the streak too. LexiChain doesn't. Everyone gets the same word chain each day — spell it out letter by letter, every letter answered from the same category, against the clock. Play it and your streak holds, win or lose. Every seventh day banks a rest day that quietly covers one you miss. Share a spoiler-free grid when you're done. Free on iPhone and iPad; paid packs optional.

posts.name: Cited.today
posts.tagline: See which articles get competitors cited by ChatGPT, not you
posts.description: Cited.today finds the exact articles that get your competitors cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini, and tells your content team what to write instead. Every morning it reads the AI answers to your buying questions, spots where a competitor is cited and you're not, links the page that got them in, and hands you the article to write with the angle and a brief built on citation research. Four weeks later it checks whether the engines now open your page. 7-day free trial.

posts.name: pawl
posts.tagline: a tiny mac focus timer you start by pulling a paw
posts.description: start a focus timer by pulling a cat paw, it lives in your mac menu bar or you can pin it like a mini timer! it has adjustable focus and break sessions, eight cat paws, themes, and a quiet heads-up before your timer ends. made for macos 14+. $9.99 once, with no subscription.

posts.name: Pikari
posts.tagline: Daily startup ideas matched to what you can build
posts.description: A daily feed of startup ideas personalized to your skills, budget, and time. Swipe to rate and the feed learns what fits you. Every idea includes a validation score, monetization paths, and a 3-step MVP roadmap. Try 10 ideas with no sign-up at pikari.app/try. Free week, no card required.

posts.name: AI PM Knowledge Graph by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: Every AI product concept and how they connect, as a 3D sky
posts.description: An interactive 3D map of 212 AI product management concepts and 1,113 connections between them: evals, guardrails, agent loops, LLM-as-a-judge, tool approval and more. Click any star to see what it is, why it matters to a PM, and which lesson teaches it. Switch to a flat labelled map or a list. Free.

posts.name: img-img.net
posts.tagline: Edit photos by describing the change in plain English
posts.description: Transform any image with AI. Upload a photo and use text prompts to change style, mood, lighting, or composition. A free image to image AI generator, no signup.

posts.name: amisleeping
posts.tagline: Your sleep in your calendar, and a calm page for family
posts.description: For WHOOP members. Your sleep, recovery, strain, steps and workouts appear in your Google, Apple or Outlook calendar. Give your partner or family abroad a link: they see whether you're asleep or awake, in their time zone. No WHOOP or app needed.

posts.name: Log: Baby Solid Food & Allergy
posts.tagline: Baby food diary with allergen schedules and PDF reports
posts.description: An iPhone food diary for parents starting solids. Log foods and reactions, follow a 14-day allergen schedule, and export PDF reports for the paediatrician. No account, and the log stays on your phone. Free to download, optional Premium.

posts.name: Pager
posts.tagline: Practise solving production incidents
posts.description: Practise production incidents without risking a real application. Investigate Linux, deployments, databases, networking, and security through simulated services. Read logs, connect to hosts, edit configuration files, and verify your repair. Choose timed challenges or practise at your own pace. No installation or account needed to start.
